subject: Post-demo: prompt capture playbook and redaction guidance for ZenBridge
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@zenbridge.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 15:12:00 +0000
Subject: Post-demo: prompt capture playbook and redaction guidance for ZenBridge

Hi Alex — thanks again for the demo earlier. Really helpful to see the three main UX flows you described (ticket triage, knowledge search, and end-user chat). Per our discussion, next steps from Redwood to make model-fit recommendations and to build an eval plan: 

- ZenBridge to share a representative sample of real prompts and a separate file with edge-case examples + any PII-sensitive patterns you want redacted. Prefer CSV (prompt, context, intent-label) where possible.
- Redwood to recommend 2–3 model variants (high-accuracy, cost-optimized, conservative-safety) and a short benchmark plan (time-to-first-token, avg latency, quality checks with 200 prompts)
- Align on redaction rules: what fields must be removed vs allowed to be pseudonymized

Could you drop the sample prompt file and edge-case list into the Drive link I created? I’ve attached a stub template and a short redaction checklist to make it quick. If you prefer, you can also upload via email reply.

Proposed internal timeline: we’ll produce model recommendations and an eval checklist by EOD Tuesday (2027-05-25) if we have the samples by Monday morning. If you need a legal/cost summary for procurement, we’ll include a draft pricing comparison.

Thanks — feel free to loop in anyone else on your side.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0182

Attachments:
- prompt_sample_template.csv (stub)
- redaction_checklist_v1.txt (stub)

From: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@zenbridge.com>

Cc: Sari Patel <sari.patel@zenbridge.com>, ZenBridge SRE <sre@zenbridge.com>
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 18:40:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Post-demo: prompt capture playbook and redaction guidance for ZenBridge

Thanks Stephanie — great session. I've attached a first pass: a CSV with 120 anonymized prompts (zenbridge_conversation_samples.csv) and a short text file listing ~15 edge cases we commonly see (zenbridge_edgecases_list.txt). A couple of notes: 

- The samples are lightly anonymized; we flagged anything that may still contain account ids (prefixed with ZB-) — those should be removed or pseudonymized before any external eval runs.
- Edge cases file calls out several long-context threads where the right answer depends on previous ticket state; those are important for quality regression checks.
- Our SRE wants to review any test traffic patterns; I’ve cc’d them.

I’m also linking our SOC2 page and a short SSO/KMS requirements doc in case you need to include compliance info in your eval. We’ll put the raw CSV into the Drive link you made by Monday morning if that works for you.

—Alex
Alex Morgan
Head of Integrations | ZenBridge
alex.morgan@zenbridge.com

Attachments:
- zenbridge_conversation_samples.csv
- zenbridge_edgecases_list.txt
- zenbridge_sso_requirements.pdf

Subject: FW: Post-demo: prompt capture playbook and redaction guidance for ZenBridge

Looping you in — Alex sent sample files (attached) and flagged long-context edge cases. Key asks for our team:

1) Quick model recommendation doc: 3 variants with expected latency/per-token cost and rough quality expectations for ZenBridge workload. Target deliverable: 1–2 pages.
2) Eval plan: canonical benchmark (200 prompts), plus a subset of 30 edge-case prompts for focused regression checks. Include acceptance thresholds (e.g., exact match or >0.8 BLEU/ROUGE? propose a more semantically meaningful metric).
3) Redaction playbook: list of fields to strip vs pseudonymize and a short process for secure upload (S3 presigned? Drive with restricted share?).

Monica — can you own the redaction playbook and secure upload recommendation? Priyom — can you draft the eval plan and the metric suggestions? Vivek — need model-performance guidance + quantization/latency knobs for Dedicated vs Hosted.

I’ve attached Alex’s files in this thread for convenience. Timebox: aim to have drafts by Tue 2027-05-25 20:00 UTC. If we need to push, call it out here.

Thanks — S

To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 23 May 2027 00:32:00 +0000
Subject: Re: FW: Post-demo: prompt capture playbook and redaction guidance for ZenBridge

Team — quick suggestions after skimming the samples and edge-case notes:

Model recommendations (initial):
- Variant A (High-accuracy): LlamaX-70B-finetuned (float16) — expected best semantic fidelity on long-contexts; estimate median p95 latency ~220ms token on Dedicated A100 equivalent.
- Variant B (Balanced/cost): Mistral-40B-8bit-quant — good tradeoff for throughput, p95 token ~140ms on quantized runtime.
- Variant C (Conservative safety): Redwood-Safe-13B-q4 — aggressive safety filters and lower hallucination risk; best for initial rollouts on customer-facing channels.

Eval plan sketch:
- Canonical set: 200 prompts sampled from CSV (stratified by intent and length).
- Edge-case subset: 30 threads with long context + stateful dependency. Measure: semantic similarity (embedding cosine) vs human labels + task-specific pass/fail for action-oriented prompts.
- Regression gates: exact-match for templated responses; >=0.85 embedding-similarity for open-ended answers; false-positive critical actions must be <2% on edge-case set.

Redaction and ingestion:
- We should ask ZenBridge to remove ZB- prefixed account IDs before sharing if they can't be pseudonymized. For secure upload: recommend S3 presigned PUT to a Redwood intake bucket with KMS encryption + limited TTL. Provide a short script.

Attachments to propose back: model_perf_estimates.csv, eval_plan_v1.md, redaction_playbook_v1.pdf

I'll draft the model_perf_estimates and attach a sample benchmark harness config for hosted vs dedicated. Priyom, Markus — can you coordinate on metric definitions and acceptance thresholds? Monica, please draft the S3 presigned workflow and a Drive option as fallback for SOC2-constrained customers.

Vivek
Principal ML Infra Engineer | Redwood Inference
vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com

Subject: Re: Post-demo: prompt capture playbook and redaction guidance for ZenBridge

Appreciate the quick turnaround, team. We’ll upload the final CSV and edge-case annotations to your Drive link by Monday 2027-05-24 14:00 PDT. Couple clarifications from our side: 

- We prefer pseudonymization (replace ZB- ids with stable pseudonyms) rather than full removal so you can test stateful behaviors. We’ll still scrub any email addresses and credit-card-like numbers.
- SRE confirmed they are OK with presigned S3 if you give us a short checklist of required KMS policies and TTL.
- We’d like to see the balanced/cost model (Variant B) results first — it’s our current target for beta.

If you can share the eval_plan_v1 and redaction_playbook_v1 by Tue EOD that gives us time to finalize the CSV. Thanks again — looking forward to the model recs.

—Alex
